description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in, and a verified referrer account. Declines a request because the candidate is not a fit. The candidate is told, by email too, with the reason if one is given. If only the CV needs work use request_cv_changes; for spam use report_referral_request.

decline_reason.description: Optional reason shown to the candidate, up to 300 characters.

name: decline_referral_request

action.description: The action that was applied: claim, release, referred, decline or request_changes.

status_label.description: The new status as techjobs.vn shows it (Vietnamese).

title: Decline a referral request
